input.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(total) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status IN ('paid', 'shipped') AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY status
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY status

text: The query reads all 2.1 M orders because no index starts with `status` or `created_at`.

An index on `(status, created_at)` lets MariaDB read only the last 30 days of paid and shipped orders.

Automatic indexing hasn't picked it up yet: it runs 212 times a day, and the threshold is **50 runs** at p95 above 100 ms over 24 hours, so it would qualify tonight.
